messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Cetirizine is a second generation antihistamine that reduces the natural chemical histamine in the body. Histamine can produce symptoms of sneezing, itching, watery eyes, and runny nose.
Cetirizine is used to treat cold or allergy symptoms such as sneezing, itching, watery eyes, or runny nose.
Cetirizine is also used to treat an allergic reaction, itching and swelling caused by chronic urticaria (hives) and minimizes or eliminates the symptoms of perennial allergic rhinitis, seasonal allergic rhinitis, chronic idiopathic urticaria, allergic asthma, physical urticaria, and atopic dermatitis.
Triplet: ["cetirizine", "minimizes symptoms of", "allergic asthma"]

The relation 'minimizes symptoms of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug reduces or lessens the occurrence or severity of the symptoms associated with the condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'may reduce response to': The subject drug may diminish the physiological or therapeutic response to the medication specified by the object entity.
B. 'has side effect variation': The occurrence or severity of side effects from the subject drug may be influenced by the object entity.
C. 'mimics symptoms of': The subject condition or drug may present symptoms that resemble those of the medical condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'lowers level of': The subject drug decreases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
